title: 第12章 啊 慧姐你怎么醒了！(1)
slug: 侯府商女全本免费-侯府商女最新章节列表
content_zh:
还省着将来朱家的女儿过门，还有这样的表妹给儿媳添堵了，就算到了日后没有爵位，有这么多的家产在好好经营一番，还是正经的官宦之家，娶了朱家的女儿，将来自己儿子还不是步步高升的事情？
大夫人虽然眼里流着眼泪，却透露出十分开心的感觉，用帕子掩着嘴，就怕笑出来被秀雁这小蹄子看见。
想那朱家是什么人家？朱家五小姐可是当朝正一品大员朱丞相之弟朱三老爷的嫡出孙女，朱五小姐是三房长子的嫡女，朱丞相是宫里朱妃的父亲，是当今圣上的岳父，虽然朱家三老爷的官职不高，其子更是一直打理朱家的庶务，但是朱家这两房如今就在一处没分家，其他几房早早的分了出去，朱家这样的人家，哪里是叶家这样的人家能比得上的？
范氏怎么算都感觉这步棋走的太好了，真真的太好了！
秀雁在跟前冷眼旁观，在看看屋子里面凌嬷嬷和四姑娘的大丫头翠兰，大夫人的大丫头翠丽，还有大少爷跟前的大丫头翠屏，秀雁都敢肯定，这些人都是过来看热闹的。
尤其是四姑娘，就差大笑几声，放串鞭炮，庆祝姑娘不省人事了！
而大夫人明明说的真情实意，可是秀雁丝毫感觉不到那种长辈对晚辈的疼爱，狭长的眼睛装满的都是算计，不停的擦眼泪，可是真丝的帕子上都没有几滴眼泪。
秀雁听娘说过，长着狭长眼睛的人最为厉害，尤其是眼角还吊起的人更要小心，眼前穿着蓝素锦制成的薄袄，在领口袖口都有精致的金色刺绣，同色系的马面裙，在正中间半尺的裙面上，是和领口相呼应的金色刺绣，梳着元宝发髻，带着赤金红宝石步摇，手上戴着羊脂玉的手镯。
最外面是一件中等皮毛的灰色大氅，屋子里面这么暖和也没有脱下来，也不怕寒着姑娘，大夫人这一身行头粗粗算来，从衣服料子再到金银首饰，有七八成都是从姑娘这里弄去的。
想到这里秀雁就暗恨姑娘被这些人给骗了，要说以前秀雁也在说服自己，这是姑娘的外祖家，不可能都惦记姑娘的东西，再者姑娘在过几个月等着老爷回来了，也出了孝期了，自然就会回到叶家，那才是她们自己的家。
可不和那个住在秋枫阁的何沛玲表姑娘不同，那个穷酸样的表姑娘可是失去双亲的，我们姑娘可是有家的，有疼爱姑娘如命根子似的老爷呢，就是二老爷和三老爷也都是疼爱姑娘的。
虽然二老爷和二夫人身子不好，这几年都在求医问药，三老爷也跟着老爷在任上，怎么也轮不到姑娘在外祖家，老爷还那么信任这些人，可惜终究是错付了信任了，姑娘变成了今天这样。
大夫人还在絮絮叨叨的说什么，贝儿已经清醒多了，只是各类的片段还很散乱，这坐在跟前演戏的玩意，一听都知道不是什么好东西，只是她身子虽然疼痛缓解了不少，但骨头肉就跟散架一样，不知道是不是被海水拍的，所以贝儿干脆就不再说话，忍着她们走了就好了。
凌嬷嬷一看时辰差不多了，这么折腾下来，已经一个时辰多了，还是夫人的身子要紧，就赶快劝道：“夫人，老奴瞧着叶表姑娘也不会马上醒来，夫人还有一府的事情要打理，那些管事娘子都等着夫人去处理事情呢，夫人您看？”
大夫人这才站起来，翠丽赶忙过来帮着大夫人整理衣襟，大夫人随时都保持最佳的姿容，翠丽也在大夫人跟前多年了，自然知道大夫人的习惯，很快便整理好了。
大夫人还很慈爱的给慧姐掖好被子，大夫人给四姑娘使个眼色，四姑娘这才不情愿的走到床前，一屁股坐在床上，想说几句难听的，但是这么多人看着又不好，憋得脸色通红的，拽着慧姐的被子道：“表妹你好好休养，明天我和娘再来看你。”
这感觉就像是再说：表妹你放心，你去了最好，便是你不去我也让你去！
大夫人这才满意的对卢代蓉道：“蓉姐给你表妹掖好被子，本来昨夜就着凉了，莫要在着凉了。”
然后大夫人对屋子里面的人训道：“你们这些奴婢要是伺候不周的话，别怪我不客气！”

content_en:
Don't worry about the daughter of the Zhu family marrying into the family in the future, and having such a cousin to cause trouble for the daughter-in-law. Even if there is no title in the future, there is so much property that is well managed, and it is still a serious official family. If you marry a daughter of the Zhu family, your son will be promoted step by step in the future?
Although the eldest lady had tears in her eyes, she showed that she was very happy. She covered her mouth with a handkerchief to avoid being seen by Xiuyan's little hooves when she smiled.
What kind of family is the Zhu family? Miss Zhu Jiawu is the direct granddaughter of Mr. Zhu San, the brother of Prime Minister Zhu, a high-ranking member of the current dynasty. Miss Zhu Wu is the legitimate daughter of the eldest son of the third wife. Prime Minister Zhu is the father of Concubine Zhu in the palace and the father-in-law of the current emperor. Although the third master of the Zhu family is His official position is not high, and his son has been taking care of the general affairs of the Zhu family. However, the two houses of the Zhu family are now in the same place, and the other houses have been separated early. How can a family like the Zhu family compare to a family like the Ye family?
No matter how much she calculated, Fan felt that this move was too good, really good!
Xiuyan was watching indifferently, looking at Granny Ling and the fourth girl's eldest girl Cuilan, the eldest lady's eldest girl Cuili, and the eldest girl Cuiping in front of the eldest young master. Xiuyan was sure that these people were here to watch the fun.
Especially the fourth girl, all she had to do was laugh a few times and set off a bunch of firecrackers to celebrate that the girl was unconscious!
The eldest lady clearly meant what she said, but Xiuyan could not feel the love of the elders for the younger ones at all. Her narrow eyes were full of calculations and she kept wiping her tears, but there were not even a few tears on the silk handkerchief.
Xiuyan heard her mother say that people with long and narrow eyes are the most powerful, especially those with hanging eyes. She was wearing a thin jacket made of blue brocade with exquisite gold embroidery on the collar and cuffs, a horse-faced skirt of the same color, and a half-foot-long skirt in the middle with gold embroidery that echoed the collar. She wore a gold ingot bun, walked with red gold and ruby ​​stones, and wore a mutton-fat jade bracelet.
The outermost part is a medium-fur gray cloak. It’s so warm inside the room that I don’t take it off, and I’m not afraid of catching the cold. The eldest lady’s entire outfit, from the clothing material to the gold and silver jewelry, 70% to 80% of it came from the girl.
Thinking of this, Xiuyan secretly hated the girl for being deceived by these people. In the past, Xiuyan had also convinced herself that this was the girl's maternal grandfather's house, and it was impossible for everyone to care about the girl's things. Moreover, the girl was waiting for the master to come back in a few months, and it was also the period of filial piety, so she would naturally return to the Ye family, which was their own home.
But unlike the cousin He Peiling who lives in Qiufeng Pavilion, that poor cousin has lost her parents, our girl has a family and a master who loves her as if she is her lifeblood. Even the second master and the third master also love the girl.
Although the second master and the second wife are in poor health and have been seeking medical advice in the past few years, and the third master has also followed the master in taking office, it is not the girl's turn to live in the ancestral home. The master still trusts these people so much, but it is a pity that he misplaced his trust and the girl has become like this.
The eldest lady was still talking nonchalantly, while Belle was much more awake, but the various clips were still scattered. It was obvious that this thing of sitting in front of her and acting in front of her was not a good thing. However, although the pain in her body had eased a lot, her bones and flesh seemed to be falling apart. She didn't know if it was caused by the sea water, so Belle simply stopped talking and endured them and left.
When Grandma Ling saw that the time was almost up, it had been more than an hour after all this tossing, but Madam's health was more important, so she quickly persuaded her: "Madam, I see that Miss Ye Biao won't wake up right away. Madam still has matters in the house to take care of, and the ladies in charge are all waiting for Madam to handle things. Madam, do you think so?"
The eldest lady then stood up, and Cuili hurried over to help the eldest lady tidy up.The eldest lady always maintains her best appearance when it comes to her clothes. Cuili has also been with the eldest lady for many years, so she naturally knows her habits and quickly sorted them out.
The eldest lady also tucked Sister Hui into the quilt very lovingly. The eldest lady gave the fourth girl a wink. Then the fourth girl reluctantly walked to the bed and sat down on the bed. She wanted to say something unpleasant, but it was not good to be watched by so many people. She suppressed it and turned red. She pulled Sister Hui's quilt and said: "Cousin, take a good rest. Mom and I will come to see you tomorrow."
This feels like saying again: Cousin, don’t worry, it’s best if you go. Even if you don’t go, I will let you go!
Only then did the eldest lady say to Lu Dai Rong with satisfaction: "Sister Rong, tuck your cousin into bed. She caught a cold last night, so don't catch a cold now."
Then the eldest lady lectured the people in the room: "If you slaves don't serve you well, don't blame me for being rude!"
